sections.title: Congress
sections.summary: Sample only. Lag can be 45 days.
sections.blurb: STOCK Act periodic transaction reports from the House and the Senate. A real row would name the member, the asset, a buy or a sell, the amount range, the trade date, and the disclosure date. Amounts on those forms are ranges, not exact sizes. Nothing below is a filing.
sections.source_name: U.S. House Clerk and U.S. Senate eFD periodic transaction reports
sections.lag: Members may disclose up to 45 days after the trade (and within 30 days of being notified). A research clock would add processing time after the filing is public. These sample rows have no dates.

sections.title: 13F funds
sections.summary: Sample only. Quarter-end snapshot, filed up to 45 days later.
sections.blurb: Form 13F is a quarter-end list of long U.S.-listed positions for a large manager, not a daily trade blotter and not a short book. A real row would name the fund, the ticker, the share of that filed portfolio, and the change versus the prior quarter’s filing. This preview does not include any manager’s actual book. The stream is meant for public filers such as large registered managers.
sections.lag: 13F filings are due up to 45 days after quarter end. The change versus last quarter compares two delayed snapshots. These sample rows have no quarter and no weights.

cards.detail: Share of filed portfolio: sample. Change vs last quarter: sample. Filing quarter: sample.
cards.why: Placeholder for a 13F line. A real card would cite the accession number and the information table.
cards.confidence: Not scored. Sample rows have no confidence.
cards.caveats: Not a filing. A 13F holding is not a buy order and is not a performance result.

sections.title: Form 4 open-market buys
sections.summary: Sample only. Open-market code P. Grants and plans are excluded.
sections.blurb: SEC Form 4 open-market purchases only (transaction code P). Grants and awards, option exercises, and 10b5-1 plan transactions are a different bucket and are not listed here, even as samples. A real row would name the company, the insider, the role, the shares, the value, and the dates.
sections.source_name: SEC EDGAR Form 4, transaction code P
sections.lag: Form 4 is due within two business days of the transaction, then a processing delay before any study could use it. Grants, exercises, and 10b5-1 plan trades are not in this list. These sample rows have no shares and no dollar value.

cards.detail: Shares: sample. Value: sample. Role: sample. Not a grant and not a 10b5-1 plan.

cards.confidence: Not scored. Sample rows have no confidence.
cards.caveats: Not a Form 4. Do not treat sample shares as a real purchase.
